commands:
set -euo pipefail
export AWS_MAX_ATTEMPTS=1 AWS_RETRY_MODE=standard AWS_PAGER=""
[[ "$SOURCE_COMMIT" =~ ^[a-f0-9]{40}$ ]]
[ "$IMAGE_TAG" = "host-assets-$SOURCE_COMMIT" ]
[ "$REPOSITORY_URI" = "967807252336.dkr.ecr.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/meri-greenfield/qualification-worker" ]
[ "$REPOSITORY_NAME" = "meri-greenfield/qualification-worker" ]
[ "$RESULT_BUCKET" = "meri-greenfield-qual-build-967807252336-us-east-1" ]
[ "$AWS_DEFAULT_REGION" = "us-east-1" ]
[ "$CODEBUILD_SOURCE_VERSION" = "$SOURCE_S3_VERSION" ]
[[ "$SOURCE_ARCHIVE_SHA256" =~ ^[a-f0-9]{64}$ ]]
python3 -I - <<'PY'
import base64, hashlib, json, os, pathlib, stat
expected=json.loads(base64.b64decode(os.environ["ASSET_EXPECTED_B64"],validate=True))
assert expected["sourceCommit"] == os.environ["SOURCE_COMMIT"]
files=expected["sourceFiles"]+[expected["ownerApp"],expected["dockerfile"],expected["buildspec"],expected["builderAuthority"]]
assert [f["path"] for f in files] == [
 "infra/browser-qualification/bootstrap.sh","infra/browser-qualification/host-evidence.py",
 "infra/browser-qualification/seccomp.chromium-155-amd64.json","infra/browser-qualification/app.mjs",
 "infra/qualification/host-assets.Dockerfile","infra/qualification/host-assets.buildspec.json",
 "infra/qualification/app.mjs"]
for f in files:
 p=pathlib.Path(f["path"]); st=p.lstat()
 assert stat.S_ISREG(st.st_mode) and st.st_nlink == 1 and not p.is_symlink()
 data=p.read_bytes()
 assert len(data)==f["bytes"] and hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()==f["sha256"], f["path"]
pathlib.Path("host-assets-expected.json").write_text(json.dumps(expected,sort_keys=True)+"\n")
PY
timeout --signal=KILL 90 aws sts get-caller-identity --region us-east-1 --output json --no-cli-pager > host-assets-build-identity.json
python3 -I - <<'PY'
import json
identity=json.load(open("host-assets-build-identity.json"))
assert identity["Account"]=="967807252336"
assert identity["Arn"].startswith("arn:aws:sts::967807252336:assumed-role/MeriGreenfield-QualificationBui-BuilderRoleBBEBFA71-8G97EeNmFM0H/")
PY
timeout --signal=KILL 90 aws ecr get-login-password --region us-east-1 | timeout --signal=KILL 90 docker login --username AWS --password-stdin 967807252336.dkr.ecr.us-east-1.amazonaws.com
timeout --signal=KILL 120 docker build --network none --pull=false --platform linux/amd64 --build-arg "SOURCE_COMMIT=$SOURCE_COMMIT" --iidfile host-assets-image-id.txt -f infra/qualification/host-assets.Dockerfile -t "$REPOSITORY_URI:$IMAGE_TAG" .
timeout --signal=KILL 30 docker image inspect "$REPOSITORY_URI:$IMAGE_TAG" > host-assets-image-inspect.json
python3 -I - <<'PY'
import json, os, re
i=json.load(open("host-assets-image-inspect.json"))
assert len(i)==1
i=i[0]
assert re.fullmatch(r"sha256:[a-f0-9]{64}",i["Id"])
assert i["Os"]=="linux" and i["Architecture"]=="amd64"
assert not i["Config"].get("Entrypoint") and not i["Config"].get("Cmd")
# BuildKit v0.17.3 dockerfile2llb/image.go sets this exact scratch default PATH.
# https://github.com/moby/buildkit/blob/v0.17.3/frontend/dockerfile/dockerfile2llb/image.go
# https://github.com/moby/buildkit/blob/v0.17.3/util/system/path.go
assert i["Config"].get("Env") in (None, [], ["PATH=/usr/local/sbin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/sbin:/usr/bin:/sbin:/bin"])
assert not i["Config"].get("Volumes")
assert i["Id"]==open("host-assets-image-id.txt").read().strip()
assert i["Config"]["Labels"]["org.opencontainers.image.revision"]==os.environ["SOURCE_COMMIT"]
assert i["Config"]["Labels"]["meri.qualification.kind"]=="browser-host-support-only"
PY
asset_id=""
cleanup_assets() {
  if [ -n "$asset_id" ]; then
    timeout --signal=KILL 30 docker rm "$asset_id" >/dev/null || echo "Owned asset-container cleanup uncertain; build must not be accepted" >&2
  elif [ -f host-assets-container-id.txt ]; then
    orphan_id=$(cat host-assets-container-id.txt)
    if [[ "$orphan_id" =~ ^[a-f0-9]{64}$ ]]; then
      timeout --signal=KILL 30 docker rm "$orphan_id" >/dev/null || echo "Owned asset-container cleanup uncertain; build must not be accepted" >&2
    fi
  fi
}
trap cleanup_assets EXIT
# Supply an inert command for Docker create; the scratch image has no CMD.
# This container is NEVER started, executed or reused as the browser container.
asset_id=$(timeout --signal=KILL 30 docker create --cidfile host-assets-container-id.txt --network none --read-only --cap-drop ALL --security-opt no-new-privileges "$REPOSITORY_URI:$IMAGE_TAG" /meri-never-start-host-assets)
[[ "$asset_id" =~ ^[a-f0-9]{64}$ ]]
[ "$(cat host-assets-container-id.txt)" = "$asset_id" ]
timeout --signal=KILL 30 docker container inspect "$asset_id" > host-assets-container-before.json
mkdir host-assets-extracted
timeout --signal=KILL 30 docker cp "$asset_id:/meri-host-assets/bootstrap.sh" host-assets-extracted/bootstrap.sh
timeout --signal=KILL 30 docker cp "$asset_id:/meri-host-assets/host-evidence.py" host-assets-extracted/host-evidence.py
timeout --signal=KILL 30 docker cp "$asset_id:/meri-host-assets/seccomp.json" host-assets-extracted/seccomp.json
timeout --signal=KILL 30 docker container inspect "$asset_id" > host-assets-container-after.json
python3 -I - <<'PY'
import hashlib, json, pathlib, stat
expected=json.load(open("host-assets-expected.json"))
cid=pathlib.Path("host-assets-container-id.txt").read_text().strip()
for name in ["before","after"]:
 ins=json.load(open("host-assets-container-"+name+".json"))
 assert len(ins)==1 and ins[0]["Id"]==cid
 assert ins[0]["Image"]==json.load(open("host-assets-image-inspect.json"))[0]["Id"]
 assert ins[0]["Config"]["Image"]==__import__("os").environ["REPOSITORY_URI"]+":"+__import__("os").environ["IMAGE_TAG"]
 s=ins[0]["State"]
 assert s["Status"]=="created" and s["Running"] is False and s["Pid"]==0
 assert s["Paused"] is False and s["Restarting"] is False and s["Dead"] is False
 assert s["OOMKilled"] is False and s["ExitCode"]==0 and s["Error"]==""
 assert s["StartedAt"]=="0001-01-01T00:00:00Z" and s["FinishedAt"]=="0001-01-01T00:00:00Z"
 assert ins[0]["RestartCount"]==0
for f in expected["sourceFiles"]:
 source=pathlib.Path(f["path"]); copied=pathlib.Path("host-assets-extracted")/f["assetPath"].rsplit("/",1)[1]
 st=copied.lstat()
 assert stat.S_ISREG(st.st_mode) and st.st_nlink==1 and not copied.is_symlink()
 data=copied.read_bytes()
 assert len(data)==f["bytes"] and hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()==f["sha256"]
 assert data==source.read_bytes(), f["path"]
PY
timeout --signal=KILL 30 docker rm "$asset_id" > host-assets-container-removed.txt
[ "$(cat host-assets-container-removed.txt)" = "$asset_id" ]
timeout --signal=KILL 30 docker container ls --all --no-trunc --filter "id=$asset_id" --format '{{.ID}}' > host-assets-container-removal-readback.txt
[ ! -s host-assets-container-removal-readback.txt ]
rm host-assets-container-id.txt
asset_id=""
trap - EXIT
timeout --signal=KILL 300 docker push "$REPOSITORY_URI:$IMAGE_TAG"
timeout --signal=KILL 90 aws ecr describe-images --region us-east-1 --repository-name meri-greenfield/qualification-worker --image-ids "imageTag=$IMAGE_TAG" --output json --no-cli-pager > host-assets-ecr-image.json
python3 -I - <<'PY'
import datetime, hashlib, json, os, pathlib, re
e=json.load(open("host-assets-ecr-image.json"))["imageDetails"]
assert len(e)==1
e=e[0]
assert e["registryId"]=="967807252336" and e["repositoryName"]=="meri-greenfield/qualification-worker"
assert os.environ["IMAGE_TAG"] in e["imageTags"] and re.fullmatch(r"sha256:[a-f0-9]{64}",e["imageDigest"])
m={"schema":"meri-host-assets-build-result/1","status":"PACKAGED_NOT_RUNTIME_QUALIFIED",
 "sourceCommit":os.environ["SOURCE_COMMIT"],"sourceArchiveSha256":os.environ["SOURCE_ARCHIVE_SHA256"],
 "sourceS3Version":os.environ["SOURCE_S3_VERSION"],"sourceBucket":"meri-greenfield-qual-build-967807252336-us-east-1",
 "sourceKey":"inputs/host-assets-"+os.environ["SOURCE_COMMIT"]+"/"+os.environ["SOURCE_ARCHIVE_SHA256"]+".zip",
 "resultBucket":"meri-greenfield-qual-build-967807252336-us-east-1",
 "resultKey":"results/host-assets-"+os.environ["SOURCE_COMMIT"]+"/manifest.json",
 "kmsKeyArn":"arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:967807252336:key/1cca74fc-d9ae-43a6-8bfd-b93107e90042",
 "imageTag":os.environ["IMAGE_TAG"],
 "imageDigest":e["imageDigest"],"imageUri":os.environ["REPOSITORY_URI"]+"@"+e["imageDigest"],
 "buildId":os.environ["CODEBUILD_BUILD_ID"],"createdAt":datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),
 "expected":json.load(open("host-assets-expected.json")),"ecrImage":e,
 "imageInspect":json.load(open("host-assets-image-inspect.json"))[0],
 "assetContainerBefore":json.load(open("host-assets-container-before.json"))[0],
 "assetContainerAfter":json.load(open("host-assets-container-after.json"))[0],
 "assetContainerRemoved":pathlib.Path("host-assets-container-removed.txt").read_text().strip(),
 "threeFixedFilesByteCompared":True,"assetContainerNeverStarted":True,
 "workerImageBuilt":False,"assetRuntimeExecuted":False,"independentDigestVerification":"NOT_RUN"}
pathlib.Path("host-assets-manifest.json").write_text(json.dumps(m,sort_keys=True,indent=2)+"\n")
PY
result_checksum=$(python3 -I -c 'import base64,hashlib;print(base64.b64encode(hashlib.sha256(open("host-assets-manifest.json","rb").read()).digest()).decode())')
timeout --signal=KILL 90 aws s3api put-object --region us-east-1 --bucket meri-greenfield-qual-build-967807252336-us-east-1 --key "results/host-assets-$SOURCE_COMMIT/manifest.json" --body host-assets-manifest.json --if-none-match '*' --server-side-encryption aws:kms --ssekms-key-id arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:967807252336:key/1cca74fc-d9ae-43a6-8bfd-b93107e90042 --checksum-algorithm SHA256 --checksum-sha256 "$result_checksum" --metadata "sourcecommit=$SOURCE_COMMIT" --output json --no-cli-pager > host-assets-result-upload.json
python3 -I - <<'PY'
import base64,hashlib,json
u=json.load(open("host-assets-result-upload.json"))
assert isinstance(u.get("VersionId"),str) and u["VersionId"] not in ["","null"]
assert u["ChecksumSHA256"]==base64.b64encode(hashlib.sha256(open("host-assets-manifest.json","rb").read()).digest()).decode()
assert u["ServerSideEncryption"]=="aws:kms"
assert u["SSEKMSKeyId"]=="arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:967807252336:key/1cca74fc-d9ae-43a6-8bfd-b93107e90042"
PY
cat host-assets-manifest.json
cat host-assets-result-upload.json
